skills.name: wassup
skills.description: Wassup — lets several Claude Code sessions on different machines (Windows PCs, Macs, Linux) work on the same project without stepping on each other and talk to each other, with no server - one writer per file, a direct channel over Remote Control (SendMessage) and a written mailbox in a shared folder. Use it when the user says "wassup", "talk to the other session / the Mac / the other PC", "read the mailbox", "sync the sessions", "don't step on each other", or when setting up a project on more than one machine.
headings: Wassup · conversations between Claude Code sessions on several machines
3b. The `wassup.mjs` script (it numbers and computes; you only write)
3e. Permissions when launching a task (so nothing gets stuck)
4. When to read (without waiting for the user)
5b. Sharing out work, "free" and resources (the coordinator doesn't work while the others watch)
5c. Incidents and reports (optional; nothing is sent automatically)
skills.description_zh: 协调Windows、Mac及Linux多台机器的Claude Code会话共用项目，按文件单写者避免覆盖，通过Remote Control SendMessage及共享目录书面邮箱通信，无须服务器。
